rows.question: My country has 12 public holidays a year and I joined with 183 days left in the year. How many public holidays do I get this year?
rows.answer:

\[ \text{Days remaining in the calendar year} ÷ 365 \times \text{Full-year public holiday entitlement} \]

Substituting the numbers:

\[ 183 ÷ 365 \times 12 = 6.027 \]

Rounded to the nearest whole day, this would be 6 public holidays for the year [S2].

This calculation ensures that new hires receive a fair allocation of public holidays based on the time they have worked in the current year, reflecting the company's commitment to fairness and inclusivity [S2].

rows.question: How much is my annual Growth and Development budget?
rows.answer:
Based on the provided context, the annual Growth and Development budget varies depending on whether you are a new hire or an existing team member:

- **New Hires:** You receive a one-time stipend of 1,500 USD (or equivalent local currency) to help set up your home office in your first year. This is not an annual budget but a one-time allocation.
- **Existing Team Members:** You have a yearly refresh amount of 500 USD (or equivalent local currency). This amount resets at the beginning of each calendar year (January 1 to December 31).

So, the annual Growth and Development budget for existing team members is 500 USD, while new hires receive a 1,500 USD stipend only once during their first year.
